office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes and other county revenue, pays the county's bills, and invests county funds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Felisha L. Rosales (Prefers Republican Party), appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Douglas County Treasurer since her 2021 appointment, with 20 years in public and private finance; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed treasurer in December 2021, elected in 2022 [S1]
Says she increased county investment interest revenue [S1]
